thesis: Root, Inc. (Nasdaq: ROOT). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-04) read in balance sheet, statements, cash flow, debt note and key metrics; 8-K Item 2.02 (2026-11-04) exhibit not read. 9M total revenue 1,164.0M vs 1,120.1M (+3.9%), net premiums earned 1,080.0M (+4.4%); Q3 net premiums earned 352.8M vs 360.1M (-2.0%), total revenue -1.7%. 9M net income 75.7M vs 35.0M, operating income 93.8M vs 51.3M, pretax 76.2M with 0.5M tax (NOL shield; accumulated loss 1,565.9M). Net combined ratio 93.5% 9M vs 97.7%, Q3 97.2% vs 102.1%; gross loss ratio 57.0% vs 57.6%; accident period loss ratio rose to 61.1% in Q3 from 56.5%; sales and marketing cut to 84.8M from 129.2M; policies in force 484,037 vs 466,320 (+3.8%). TTM pretax about 81.6M (FY2025 40.8 - 35.4 + 76.2) and net income about 81.0M (40.3 - 35.0 + 75.7). Equity 327.0M plus 112.0M redeemable convertible preferred (redemption value 126.5M, 14.1M shares; conversion terms not read). Shares 13,386,013 Class A + 1,806,236 Class B at 2026-10-28 = 15,192,249; close 37.01 (2026-11-20, two sources agree; down 11.9% that day from 42.00 and 18% from 45.19 on 11-16, cause not found) gives market cap 562.3M on basic shares: 6.9x TTM earnings, 1.72x common equity. As-converted preferred would raise the share count (unverified), so the multiples are understated. Debt: 199.5M senior secured term loan due May 2029 (refinanced May 2026, 4.9M extinguishment loss), minimum cash and risk-based capital covenants. 9M buybacks 36.2M. Cash 596.3M plus investments 433.7M. Market view possible: earnings are cyclical after a favourable pricing period and growth has stalled; evidence differing: combined ratio improved with lower marketing, positive operating cash flow, deleveraging efforts.
counterthesis: Q3 premiums fell 2% and policies grew only 3.8% after the marketing cut, so earnings may peak as auto pricing softens; accident period loss ratio worsened to 61.1% in Q3 and the net combined ratio 97.2% leaves little margin; 9M earnings are boosted by near zero taxes from NOLs that will not last indefinitely, and by favourable prior period development (not read); reserves are 493.1M with only a short operating history of profit (FY2025 NI 40.3M); the preferred and Class B structure and unread conversion terms may dilute common holders; secured term loan covenants require net worth, debt service coverage and risk based capital minimums; a 12% one day drop with unknown cause may reflect news not yet read; reinsurance recoverables and counterparties not examined.
invalidation: Drop if the net combined ratio rises above 100% on a trailing basis, premiums keep falling, covenant headroom shrinks, preferred conversion dilutes materially, or the 11-20 drop traces to a regulatory, rating or reserve issue. Study further only with peers (PGR, LMND, HIPO, KINS), reserve development, statutory capital, and documented quote origins.
